question: On p1, can this account verify the runtime memory component inventory, including each component name and current byte size? Identify the dictionary source you attempted and any access limitation. Do not substitute initialization settings for the runtime inventory.

groundTruth.sql: SELECT v.view_name FROM (SELECT 'V$SGA_DYNAMIC_COMPONENTS' view_name FROM dual) v WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM all_tab_privs WHERE table_schema='SYS' AND table_name IN ('V_$SGA_DYNAMIC_COMPONENTS','V_$MEMORY_DYNAMIC_COMPONENTS') AND privilege='SELECT' AND grantee IN (SELECT role FROM session_roles UNION ALL SELECT SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SESSION_USER') FROM dual UNION ALL SELECT 'PUBLIC' FROM dual)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM session_privs WHERE privilege IN ('SELECT ANY DICTIONARY','SELECT ANY TABLE','READ ANY TABLE'))
